dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I couldn't find any tales of the supernatural here. But I think I may have found something even more interesting...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: See these? Both the art style and the prose would make you think they're written for children, and yet...

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: I just get this uncanny feeling after reading them, it's hard to describe, but... Ugh, I think I need to start by reading them a few more times.
